top_deficiency_types.title: Install corridor and hallway doors that block smoke.
Ensure heating and ventilation systems that have been properly installed according to the manufacturer's instructions.
Ensure that corridors are separated from use areas by walls constructed to limit the passage of smoke.
Have properly installed electrical wiring and gas equipment.
Ensure proper usage of power strips and extension cords.

top_deficiency_types.title: Procure food from sources approved or considered satisfactory and store, prepare, distribute and serve food in accordance with professional standards.

Implement gradual dose reductions(GDR) and non-pharmacological interventions, unless contraindicated, prior to initiating or instead of continuing psychotropic medication; and PRN orders for psychotropic medications are only used when the medication is necessary and PRN use is limited.

Try different approaches before using a bed rail.  If a bed rail is needed, the facility must (1) assess a resident for safety risk; (2) review these risks and benefits with the resident/representative; (3) get informed consent; and (4) Correctly install and maintain the bed rail.

top_deficiency_types.title: Ensure medication error rates are not 5 percent or greater.
